depth_justification: Strongly engages the exact fact pattern (optional clinician sharing under GDPR Art. 9(2)(h) care-related processing, the wellness-vs-medical reclassification under MDR Art. 1(2)/ISO 82304-2) with mostly correct precise citations, but is heavily undermined by verbatim repetition—both the clinician-sharing and the wellness turns produce near-identical duplicated blocks—plus drifting dimension IDs and a wrong Art. 18 'portability' citation.
actionability_justification: Provides concrete, implementable recipes (AES-256 at rest, TLS in transit, role-based access, audit logs, separate per-purpose consent mechanism, DPIA + record of processing, automated deletion) and delivers the requested severity-grouped report with a mitigation under each dimension.
